moved.release-pipeline: .github/workflows/build.yml (one workflow for APK, desktop and web bundle; replaces release.yml, see notes)

notes: TurboCut is a vanilla TypeScript app (no React, no Tailwind), so the engine's React files are followed as conventions, not copied: hook classes, tab recipe, dialog structure, panel cards, asset naming, version scheme, docs layout, guides inside Settings. Differences on purpose: (1) builds also run for claude/** branches and publish pre-releases, because the owner tests every branch on a phone; (2) no auto-pr.yml, the owner does not want pull requests unless asked; (3) check.yml is ci.yml and runs on every push; (4) turbothemes is still installed from the retired TurboNZL/turbothemes repository until the dependency can be moved to turboengine#path:/themes (the move needs an install that could not be run from the cloud session); (5) editions, window-frame, settings-shell and android-shell are not used: TurboCut has one edition, a native-looking window, and a plain Capacitor Android shell.
